subject: Vendor onboarding: VAT attribute mapping & PO routing for academic suppliers
messages:
From: Elsa Mortimer <procurement@westbridge.ac.uk>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Accounts Payable <accounts-payable@westbridge.ac.uk>
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Vendor setup: Redwood Inference — VAT proof and bulk onboarding

Hi Laura,

Thanks for taking the call earlier — per our discussion we need to get Redwood set up in our supplier system before we can raise blanket POs for research credits. A few specific asks from our side: 

- Can you confirm the legal entity Redwood wants invoices routed to for EU purchases (we need invoice recipient + VAT ID to apply reverse-charge where appropriate).
- Please share a copy of your VAT certificate and any tax residency attestation for non-US entities.
- We have a bulk onboarding feed for campus departments (CSV or XML). Do you support a bulk-upload spec or SFTP?

Attached is our supplier intake checklist for academic partners (WB-supplier-checklist.pdf) — I also attached the VAT certificate we have on file for the vendor you referenced (if different, please send updated docs).

Attachment: WB-vat-certificate.pdf (application/pdf, 120 KB)

Happy to run through the fields live if helpful — small teams often get stuck on the PO entity vs billing address mapping.

Thanks,
Elsa Mortimer
Senior Procurement Officer
Westbridge University
procurement@westbridge.ac.uk

-----Original Message-----
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elsa Mortimer <procurement@westbridge.ac.uk>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 10:08:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Vendor setup: Redwood Inference — VAT proof and bulk onboarding

Hi Elsa — thanks for the note and the checklist. Looping in Ben (Tax & AP) and Karthik (EMEA onboarding) so we can share the right artifacts and confirm routing.

Quick answers and next steps: 

1) Invoice routing / legal entity: For EU academic customers we recommend invoicing to Redwood EU B.V. (NL) for software subscription / hosted API charges — that enables local VAT handling and simplifies reverse-charge. If the purchase is for professional services provided by a local subcontractor, we can discuss alternate routing.

2) VAT proof & tax residency: Attached is our standard vendor onboarding packet: RI-vendor-onboard-form.pdf. We also have a VAT certificate and tax residency letter for Redwood EU B.V.; Ben will attach the cert and confirm the exact VAT number to map into your PO fields.

3) Bulk onboarding / file spec: We support a CSV bulk upload and have an SFTP endpoint for secure transfers. See attached PO-mapping-template.csv and a short bulk-upload-spec.xlsx describing field names. Two notes on the mapping: 
   - Please use the field "invoice_entity" to select the invoicing entity in your system (values: REDWOOD_US_INC | REDWOOD_EU_BV | REDWOOD_ASIA_PTY).
   - For VAT handling, map the supplier VAT number to column VAT_ID and set VAT_TREATMENT to one of: REVERSE_CHARGE | VAT_EXEMPT | STANDARD. We do not expect academic exemptions automatically — please indicate "VAT_EXEMPT" only if you have formal exemption docs.

4) Academic/non-profit handling: If Westbridge qualifies suppliers as "academic/non-profit" in your system, flag this separately in TAX_CLASS. We will honor special handling on a case-by-case basis, but we need the official certificate (charity/registration) to set TAX_CLASS=ACADEMIC.

Next steps: Ben — can you attach the VAT certificate + confirm the VAT_ID string? Karthik — I'll need you to confirm the SFTP details and a contact for our onboarding team to coordinate the bulk upload.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Finance Operations (EMEA)
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: RI-vendor-onboard-form.pdf (application/pdf, 48 KB)
Attachment: PO-mapping-template.csv (text/csv, 6 KB)
Attachment: bulk-upload-spec.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 12 KB)

Thanks Laura / Elsa — quick technical clarifications from tax/AP: 

- VAT number (Redwood EU B.V.): NL123456789B01 (please map exactly to VAT_ID, do not insert spaces or country flags).
- Reverse-charge: For taxable services to a VAT-registered university in the EU, set VAT_TREATMENT=REVERSE_CHARGE on the PO line(s) and include the buyer VAT number in the invoice header.
- Invoice address vs remit-to: Please route invoices to Redwood EU B.V. (billing address on the vendor form). Bank details for wire (if needed) will be issued once the supplier is live — we prefer ACH/SEPA where possible.

Attachment: none (see Laura's onboarding packet).

If you want, we can provision a temporary SFTP drop for a one-off CSV bulk upload. Karthik, can you confirm SFTP host + user expiry window?

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Manager, Global AP & Tax
ben_carter@redwood.com

Hi Laura / Ben / Karthik,

Thanks for the clear answers — that helps a lot. A couple follow-ups from our supplier team: 

- We will map invoice_entity=REDWOOD_EU_BV and VAT_TREATMENT=REVERSE_CHARGE for the campus POs.
- I attached the VAT certificate we have on file for our records — please confirm if the NL123456789B01 you provided matches that cert (we'll accept WL-signed PDF).
- For the bulk upload, CSV is preferred. Can you confirm the exact header name for the VAT flag field? Our vendor system has both "VATFlag" (boolean) and "Taxable" (tax code); which should we populate?

Proposed plan: we will prepare a CSV using your PO-mapping-template.csv, set VAT_ID = NL123456789B01, VAT_TREATMENT = REVERSE_CHARGE, and leave TAX_CLASS blank unless you confirm an academic exemption. We'll send a test file to the SFTP you provision.

Attachment: WB-vat-certificate.pdf (application/pdf, 120 KB)

Thanks,
Elsa
Procurement — Westbridge University
